sentences.text: Javed vs State Of U.P. on 19 April, 2023

Author: Subhash Chandra Sharma
Bench: Subhash Chandra Sharma
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 82
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 1801 of 2023
Applicant :- Javed

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Nafees Ahmad Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Chandra Sharma,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned AGA for the State and perused the material placed on record.

This anticipatory bail application has been moved seeking anticipatory bail in Case Crime No.38 of 2022, under sections 498A and 323 I.P.C and 3/4 D.P. Act and section 3/4 of Muslim Women (Prevention of the Right of Marriage) Act, 2019, Police Station Saidangali, District Amroha.

entities.text: Muslim Women (Prevention of the Right of Marriage) Act, 2019
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that in this case the applicant is husband of the informant and have committed no offence.
It is further submitted that he never made harassment to the informant who have one female child living with him but the informant is not ready to live with him and is living at Amroha.
Now the investigation is going on and the applicant is ready to face the trial

It is further submitted that all the offences said to be committed by the applicant are punishable with sentence less then seven years, therefore, a direction be given to the learned court concerned to dispose of the bail application in accordance with law laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Javed vs State Of U.P. on 19 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/125553731/
1 Bureau of Investigation and another LL 2021 SC 550.
Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer as aforesaid.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Javed vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A and perusal of record it is directed that, if applicant appears and moves bail application before the concerned court within 30 days from today, the same shall be heard and decided as expeditiously as possible in the light of the law laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another LL 2021 SC 550.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another LL 2021 SC 550
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Accordingly, this anticipatory bail application is disposed of.
